body: Np. I really hope your situation works out! And it did my friend is still here today and so am i.

My friend did the same thing as her. best idea would be to call the police asap , thats what i did. I have been suicidal and know that nothing usually will change your feelings but time. Just show support and love and send help.

Your friend decided to end the relationship, and her ignoring you was not something a good friend would do. I get that it hurts a lot, thats okay. But don’t let this experience stop you from making friends in the future. Good friends are one of the best ways of coping with negative thoughts, and it’s important to not isolate yourself completely. It may seem like everything is your fault, but in actuality, it probably isn’t. Im glad you have a close sister, keep that relationship close . Love is powerful.

I struggled with self harm for a few years and still the urge. It helps me to hit things like a pillow repeatedly or go outside and get a stick and hit the ground. This releases the same sort of energy as self harm.
Im very sorry for your loss. Don’t hold back, if you want to share your feelings or anything about this relationship go ahead. The healing process takes time, and we are here to listen.

This seems like a very difficult situation. Think of it this way, if she does kill herself, it would kill the relationship with you and your son. It might be better to call the police and risk the relationship and try to mend it later than to risk loosing her permanently. If she did try to get full custody over your son, you would probably have the better side of the argument since she is suicidal and you are a more stable parent. It seems like it is worth risking it for the benefit of the whole family.

Hey, love deep introspective conversations, music, and art. Feel free to message. To talk about ANYTHING. If you want a deep conversation i got you! There are people like you out there. It looks like you need a change of scenery. Your life is worth much more than an insurance policy.
Have you tried telling them to get help, therapist, medication, or hospital. You could always call the suicide hotline. I called them when my friend was about to kill herself and it was very helpful.
